## Workload

Chloe Mensah graded 328 sets during 495 rostered hours. This equates to a recorded throughput of 0.7 sets per hour. The workload was reviewed against the available grading hours, with the recorded output providing the basis for the assessment.

The review indicates that the grading activity was completed within the hours recorded. No further workload issues were identified in the material considered for this review.

## Quality

A sample of 24 graded sets was checked as part of the quality review. The level of agreement was 83.3 per cent. This result was considered alongside the checked work and the observations made during the review.

Feedback was provided on borderline background cases to support consistent decisions and clarify the expected approach where the available information was less clear.

The review was completed by Priya Anand.
